metadata.title: CCCS ITSP.10.171 Profile
metadata.remarks:
October 28, 2025 second release. Includes the actual numbered ITSP.10.171 requirements, discussions and Annex B parameter inventory, as well as every Annex A source control marked C. The source-control crosswalk is supporting context, not a substitute for the numbered requirements or their tailoring. Organization-defined parameters require organization-specific decisions. Requirement text: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security, Protecting specified information in non-Government of Canada systems and organizations (ITSP.10.171), October 28, 2025; an unofficial reproduction of the publication at the reference URL.

Control text: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security, Security and privacy controls and assurance activities catalogue (ITSP.10.033), March 31, 2026; an unofficial reproduction of the publication at the reference URL. Source text is Crown copyright, reproduced under the Government of Canada non-commercial reproduction terms, not the repository's MIT-0 software license. Commercial redistribution requires permission. This transcription is not endorsed by the Government of Canada.
